quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Banana!
quests.question: b
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Banana. ⚽
quests.explanation: Great job! You found b, the letter that starts Banana. 🍌
quests.funFact: Bananas are technically classified as berries!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Cloud!
quests.question: c
quests.hint: It comes right after B.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found c. It comes right before D.
quests.funFact: A single fluffy cloud can weigh as much as 100 elephants!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Dog!
quests.question: d
quests.hint: It has a small circle with a tall straight line on the right side.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found d. It comes right after C.
quests.funFact: A dog's sense of smell is 40 times stronger than a human's!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Elephant!
quests.question: E
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Elephant. 🐘
quests.explanation: Great job! You found E, the letter that starts Elephant. 🐘
quests.funFact: Elephants are the only mammals that can't jump!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Flower!
quests.question: F
quests.hint: It comes right after E.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found F. It comes right before G.
quests.funFact: Sunflowers track the sun across the sky during the day!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Ghost!
quests.question: G
quests.hint: It has a big curved line like C, with a small hook at the bottom.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found G. It comes right after F.
quests.funFact: In old stories, ghosts were just a way to explain the wind rattling old houses!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Honey!
quests.question: h
quests.hint: This is the letter tHoney starts Honey. 🍯
quests.explanation: Great job! You found h, the letter tHoney starts Honey. 🍯
quests.funFact: Honey never goes bad; you could eat honey from 3,000 years ago!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Iguana!
quests.question: i
quests.hint: It comes right after H.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found i. It comes right before J.
quests.funFact: Iguanas have a 'third eye' on top of their heads to detect light and shadows!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Jacket!
quests.question: j
quests.hint: It has a curved hook with a small dot on top.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found j. It comes right after I.
quests.funFact: The first jackets with zippers were made in the 1920s!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Key!
quests.question: K
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Key. 🔑
quests.explanation: Great job! You found K, the letter that starts Key. 🔑
quests.funFact: The oldest known keys were made of wood over 4,000 years ago!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Lighthouse!
quests.question: L
quests.hint: It comes right after K.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found L. It comes right before M.
quests.funFact: The first lighthouse in the world was built in ancient Egypt!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Mouse!
quests.question: M
quests.hint: It has two tall lines with a peak dipping down between them, like mountains.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found M. It comes right after L.
quests.funFact: Mice use their whiskers to feel changes in temperature and find their way in the dark!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Nest!
quests.question: n
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Nest. 🪹
quests.explanation: Great job! You found n, the letter that starts Nest. 🪹
quests.funFact: Some birds build their nests using mud, spiderwebs, and even their own saliva!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Orange!
quests.question: o
quests.hint: It comes right after N.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found o. It comes right before P.
quests.funFact: Oranges are actually a type of modified berry!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Pig!
quests.question: p
quests.hint: It has a tall line that dips below, with a round bump on top.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found p. It comes right after O.
quests.funFact: Pigs are incredibly smart and can learn to play simple video games!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Queen!
quests.question: Q
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Queen. 👑
quests.explanation: Great job! You found Q, the letter that starts Queen. 👑
quests.funFact: Queen bees are the only bees in the hive that lay eggs!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Rabbit!
quests.question: R
quests.hint: It comes right after Q.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found R. It comes right before S.
quests.funFact: A rabbit's teeth never stop growing, so they have to constantly chew!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Sun!
quests.question: S
quests.hint: It has a curvy line that curls one way then the other.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found S. It comes right after R.
quests.funFact: Over one million Earths could fit inside the Sun!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Tree!
quests.question: t
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Tree. 🌳
quests.explanation: Great job! You found t, the letter that starts Tree. 🌳
quests.funFact: Trees are the longest-living organisms on Earth. Some are thousands of years old!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Umbrella!
quests.question: u
quests.hint: It comes right after T.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found u. It comes right before V.
quests.funFact: Umbrellas were originally invented to protect people from the sun, not the rain!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Van!
quests.question: v
quests.hint: It has two short lines meeting in a point at the bottom, like a checkmark.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found v. It comes right after U.
quests.funFact: The first vans were drawn by horses and used to move furniture!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Watermelon!
quests.question: W
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Watermelon. 🍉
quests.explanation: Great job! You found W, the letter that starts Watermelon. 🍉
quests.funFact: Watermelons are 92% water, making them perfect for a hot summer day!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Xylophone!
quests.question: X
quests.hint: It comes right after W.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found X. It comes right before Y.
quests.funFact: The word xylophone comes from ancient Greek words meaning 'wood sound'!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Yo-yo!
quests.question: Y
quests.hint: It has two short lines meeting in the middle, sitting on one straight line.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found Y. It comes right after X.
quests.funFact: The yo-yo is believed to be the second oldest toy in history, right after the doll!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Zebra!
quests.question: z
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Zebra. 🦓
quests.explanation: Great job! You found z, the letter that starts Zebra. 🦓
quests.funFact: A zebra's stripes are completely unique—like human fingerprints!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Apple!
quests.question: a
quests.hint: It comes right before B.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found a. It's the very first letter of the alphabet!
quests.funFact: Apples float in water because they are 25% air!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Ball!
quests.question: b
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with one round bump at the bottom.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found b. It comes right after A.
quests.funFact: The first rubber balls were made in ancient Mexico thousands of years ago!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Cat!
quests.question: C
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Cat. 🐱
quests.explanation: Great job! You found C, the letter that starts Cat. 🐱
quests.funFact: Cats have a special collarbone that helps them almost always land on their feet!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Dolphin!
quests.question: D
quests.hint: It comes right after C.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found D. It comes right before E.
quests.funFact: Dolphins sleep with one eye open to watch out for danger!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Eagle!
quests.question: E
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with three short lines like little shelves.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found E. It comes right after D.
quests.funFact: An eagle's eyes are so powerful they can spot a rabbit from two miles away!
